body.name: Independent weighted-erasure experiment
body.construction: \(P_K=\bigotimes_{l=1}^L\operatorname{Bernoulli}(q_l)\), \(O=((K_l,K_lV_l))_{l=1}^L\), and \(Q_t=\pi_t\otimes P_K\otimes\operatorname{Uniform}[0,1]\) on \((V,K,R)\). Thus \(K\) is independent of \(V\), and the external randomizer \(R\) is independent of \((V,K)\), under every \(Q_t\).
